Theme

concrete noun

modern

Vitruvius 2.4.1: in caementīciīs autem strūctūrīs
Vitruvius 2.8.17: parietibus caementīciīs

opus caementīcium, operis caementīciī n.

The modern name for Roman concrete, built on Vitruvius’s caementīcius, “of rubble stones”; used here for modern concrete too.

Other words

  • 1Traupman 168 has concrētum, which is not used: classical concrētus means “thickened, congealed”. Ruling: opus caementīcium for concrete.

    concrētum1

    noun, second declension · avoid · modern · Traupman 168; Traupman 295

See also cement, concrete worker, rubble.
